result.title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
result.summary: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验 LLM-agent 意见模拟中概率报告的「补集一致性」：把主张改写为补集并将 p 换成 1-p 后，两次报告本应相加为 1；作者在 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-3-4B 上，用模拟中的 2,304 个 agent 状态、AVeriTeC 的 48 条真实主张和 24 个二结果受控世界测试，发现求和系统性偏离 1，且该偏差在重复采样与不同群体规模下持续存在，反馈到互补初始群体后两侧也不再镜像；用「答案与其配对答案补集的平均」可按构造恢复一致性并降低 Brier 损失，但末轮仅一个模型优于原始表述中较优者。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「同义改写/补集改写不变性」探测协议与补集平均聚合，可能可供核查 LVR 中的 latent 状态究竟编码任务语义内容还是表面措辞（如 latent 相似度对改写的敏感性）；但该工作纯文本、无视觉证据与推理轨迹，仅为间接方法线索，需核查其诊断设计能否迁移到多模态内部状态评估。
